entities.summary: Dorothy West was an American novelist, short-story writer, and magazine editor associated with the Harlem Renaissance, a cultural movement in the 1920s and 1930s that celebrated black art, literature, and music. She was one of the few Black women writers to be published in major literary magazines in the 1930s and 1940s. Dorothy West was a authors & novelists from Boston (1907-06-02, Boston–1998-08-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
